s.note: Sweet peanut butter discs dipped in colored candy melts
s.how: Beat 200g peanut butter with 100g icing sugar and 30g soft butter. Roll into small discs and chill 30 minutes. Dip in 250g melted coloured candy melts and set on baking paper. Lay them in a trail across the table.

s.note: Crisp cheddar and butter crackers cut into letter shapes
s.how: Pulse 150g grated cheddar, 60g cold butter and 100g flour with salt until it forms a dough, adding a splash of water. Roll thin and cut into letters with small cutters. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until crisp.

m.note: Thin crust pizza with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, cut into squares
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with pizza sauce and top with 250g mozzarella and 100g pepperoni. Bake on a steel or tray at the oven's highest heat for 7 to 8 minutes, then cut into squares.

w.note: Milk chocolate cups filled with sweet peanut butter
w.how: Melt 300g milk chocolate. Spoon a little into 12 cupcake liners and chill. Mix 150g peanut butter with 50g icing sugar and put a spoon on each. Cover with the rest of the chocolate and chill until set.

d.note: Root beer over vanilla ice cream with a drizzle of chocolate syrup
d.how: Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes. Add 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream to each glass. Slowly pour 250ml cold root beer down the side of each glass so the foam rises without spilling over. Top with a drizzle of chocolate syrup and serve straight away with long spoons and straws.
